$comment: JSON Schema assertions over everything in the seed that has a schema. The runner executes them only when an engine is supplied (--schemas <module url>), because the seed ships no dependencies; a consumer that already has an engine runs the same assertions against its pinned snapshot. Optional id names a case; optional mutations use tools/mutations.mjs on a copy of the pointed value before validation.
checkedWith: ajv 8.20.0, { allErrors: true, strict: false, validateFormats: false }
note: the engine and the options are the ones the sealed legacy validator used, so a pass here means what a pass meant there

assertions.note: a colour key matches stored bytes, so a key stated as linear floats is refused rather than rounded
a registered descriptor must satisfy the descriptor schema, so an incomplete descriptor cannot be registered by accident
a candidate descriptor satisfies the same schema as a registered one: candidate says the scope is not a compatibility guarantee, not that it may be incomplete
